reviews.text: I love my cats new haircut! Alexandra and them are so very kind and helpful, giving great advice and taking care of my cat even though she is difficult to deal with, I recommend if you want a good quality care and kind service :)

Thank you so much, Daniela! We’re so glad you had a great experience with us. We work hard to keep our prices fair while giving every pet the time and care they deserve, so it means a lot to hear that. 

- Le Pitou

⭐ 1 STAR — BUYER BEWARE — ABSOLUTELY UNACCEPTABLE

My sister has been a loyal customer of Le Pitou Pets Boutique for YEARS. She continued going there because she believed in supporting a local business. Unfortunately, after what happened during her most recent visit, that loyalty is over.

For years, there has been a recurring issue with the credit card machine supposedly not working, leaving her to pay in cash. We tolerated it because we wanted to support the business.

But the prices have now become completely unreasonable. Her cat’s service was normally around $100. Then it increased to approximately $150, then $175, and this time she was suddenly told she owed $475.

$475.

And according to my sister, her cat received nothing different or additional compared with previous visits.

When we questioned this enormous and unexpected charge and refused to simply hand over $475 without a satisfactory explanation, instead of resolving the issue professionally, the police were called.

Let that sink in.

A longtime customer questions an unexplained $475 charge, and rather than having a reasonable conversation about the bill, the police are called.

Customers have every right to ask what they are being charged for. Customers have every right to question a price that has increased so dramatically. And customers certainly shouldn't feel pressured into paying a charge they don't understand.

This entire experience was extremely disappointing and completely unacceptable.

If you are considering bringing your pet here, I strongly recommend that you ask for the complete price upfront, make sure you understand exactly what services are included, and get the price in writing before anything is done.

After years of supporting this business, my sister will never spend another dollar here.

Loyalty should mean something. Unfortunately, this experience made us feel like it didn't.
Job well done absolutely great service recommend highly!!!!!!!

Rudest owner ever. I used to take my Pom here, but thankfully I found a much better place where she’s actually treated with love and care. They once left her sitting in the bathing area for HOURS because they were “too busy,” then had the nerve to tell me she was trying to bite them. Maybe she simply picked up on the bad energy, dogs are pretty good judges of character. 🤷🏻‍♀️ Needless to say, we never looked back
We absolutely adore this shop. The ladies are very kind, professional and loving to my baby (calico).

Le Pitou is our go to spot for dog grooming and recently we started using them for boarding when we have needed to go out of town. Alexandra and her team are wonderful and take good care of our Walter! If you are looking for pet services, you can’t go wrong here!
Le Pitou is one of my favorite locally owned places to support. Alex and her staff are always super friendly, fun, and accommodating. The shop is always clean and organized. 5 stars.
